article.title: No presente perfectivo
article.chapter: Aspecto imperfectivo/perfectivo: fundamentos — Вид глагола: основы

claims.summary: In Russian, perfective verbs do not have a present tense indicating current action. Their personal forms that resemble the present are normally interpreted as future.
The perfective aspect presents actions as units with a limit, result, or culmination. An action truly happening 'now' is not normally expressed with a perfective form equivalent to a simple present.

Examples are provided to illustrate the use of perfective verbs to express future actions, such as 'Я сделаю это завтра' (I will do this tomorrow) and 'Она напишет письмо вечером' (She will write the letter in the evening).
